description: This line plot illustrates length extrapolation results on the EgoSchema dataset by representing the performance of four different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and features a linear scale encompassing a data range from 8 to 64, with numeric tick labels marked at regular intervals of 10 from 10 to 60. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and employs a linear scale with a plotted range from roughly 39 to 54.5, displaying tick labels at regular intervals of 2 from 40 to 54. The line for "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" is plotted as a thick solid blue line with circular markers outlined in white; it begins at an x-value of 8 with a y-value of approximately 53, rises to a peak of 54 at x=16, and then exhibits a slight decline to approximately 53.8 at x=32 before ending at roughly 53.6 at x=64. The line representing "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" appears as a thick solid green line with white-outlined circular markers, starting at x=8 with an accuracy of approximately 52.6, increasing to roughly 53.6 at x=16, rising slightly to about 53.8 at x=32, and remaining steady at that value until the end of the data range at x=64. The "PLLaVA (DP 8)" line is a thick solid orange line with white-outlined square markers; it begins at x=8 with a value of 45 and shows a continuous decline across its plotted points, dropping to 43 at x=16, 41 at x=32, and concluding at approximately 39.4 at x=64. Finally, the "PLLaVA (DP 16)" line is depicted as a thick solid red line with white-outlined square markers that commences at x=16 with a value of approximately 45.6, then steadily declines to about 43.8 at x=32 and finishes at roughly 42.2 at x=64.
